# sspi_platforms (Data Source)

Lists every SSP/Avi Operations platform deployment known to the SSPI appliance.

Corresponds to `GET /sspi/platforms`. Returns all results in a single page (no offset/page_size pass-through); use `data.sspi_platform` for the full configuration of a specific platform.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The platforms known to the SSPI appliance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `desired_state` (String) Most recently requested desired state for the platform's LCM workflow.
- `form_factor` (String) Deployment form factor.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the platform.
- `instance_name` (String) Cluster/instance name of the platform.
- `ssp_type` (String) Platform instance type (e.g. `ATP`, `AVI_OPERATIONS`).
